chapters.label: The save, live
chapters.text: Lyon, 2019: the World Cup semi-final. England trail the USA two-one, and win a late penalty. Captain Steph Houghton steps up. Alyssa Naeher waits on her line... Houghton shoots low. Naeher dives to her right. Saved!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from behind the goal. Naeher stays patient and watches the kicker's body. Then she pushes off hard.

chapters.label: Smothered
chapters.text: Both hands smother the ball by the post, and her teammates mob her!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, stay patient. Watch the kicker's hips and planting foot. Then push off strongly toward the ball.
